_help: VULPHEX's brains. HYBRID: the fast NVIDIA cloud model handles chat + study (instant, no download); the uncensored ancestor model (Kaggle GPU) handles plan + coach — so the model that TRAINS and proposes tactics has no refusals, while chat stays fast. Needs the NVIDIA_API_KEY set for chat; the uncensored model loads on the GPU the first time a plan/coach runs. The router picks one per job. Keys come from the environment (NVIDIA_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY).
